name: GD-AI RL Master
description: In-game Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) reinforcement learning agent that trains to master Geometry Dash levels with a live statistics HUD, vision overlay, and analytics dashboard.

ai-enabled.name: Enable AI Agent
ai-enabled.description: Master switch for AI control when entering a level.

training-mode.name: Training Mode
training-mode.description: When enabled, the agent explores and updates its neural network via PPO. Disable for deterministic Evaluation / Play mode.

show-hud.name: Show Live Stats HUD
show-hud.description: Display the compact real-time RL statistics overlay and progress chart during gameplay.

show-vision.name: Show AI Vision Overlay
show-vision.description: Render the AI's egocentric obstacle perception grid directly over the level.

per-level-model.name: Per-Level Model Specialization
per-level-model.description: Save and load a separate model per level ID instead of sharing one global generalist master brain.

auto-save.name: Auto-Save Best Models
auto-save.description: Automatically persist neural network weights when a new best percentage or rolling reward record is achieved.

training-speed.name: Training Time Scale
training-speed.description: Physics speedup multiplier during training mode (1.0 = normal speed, up to 4.0 = 4x faster training).

decision-interval.name: Decision Tick Interval
decision-interval.description: Number of physics frames between RL policy decisions (1 = every frame, 2 = balanced).
